description: Points another address at a mailbox: mail sent to it lands in that box, threads there and counts against the storage of the account. An alias has no password, no seat and no storage of its own, and the number one box may carry is limited; list_mailboxes gives the limit and what is already used.

address.description: The address of the mailbox, for example "marie@sonentreprise.com": call list_mailboxes to find it. A support queue is not a mailbox: it has no holder and takes no alias.

alias.description: The other address to point at this box, for example "webmaster@sonentreprise.com". It must be free and on a domain of the account: an address already used by the platform, or one on the domain of another account, is refused.

name: add_mailbox_alias
title: Add another name to a mailbox
